result.reason: The redline appropriately covers Affiliates and contractors and limits termination during the term to uncured material breach. However, it does not make paid-up licences perpetual and irrevocable, and the new successor-transfer right directly conflicts with retained subsection (c), which still prohibits assignment or transfer. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve the Field of Use and other commercial restrictions, but the operative inconsistency and incomplete treatment of paid-up licences prevent compliance.
